product_family: Amper Music is an AI-driven music generation platform acquired by Shutterstock in November 2020. It enables users to create original, royalty-free music using AI composition. The platform is now integrated into Shutterstock's broader content ecosystem and is available via web app, mobile app (iOS/Android), and API for 10,000+ integrations.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification on Shutterstock's own domain; the only claim originates from a third-party aggregator (Nudge Security), which is not vendor-domain proof.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on Shutterstock's own domain; the only claim originates from a third-party aggregator (Nudge Security), which is not vendor-domain proof.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of GDPR compliance on Shutterstock's own domain; the only claim originates from a third-party aggregator (Nudge Security), which is not vendor-domain proof.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or Business Associate Agreement support on the vendor domain. Shutterstock is a media licensing platform, not a healthcare covered entity or business associate; the third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) claim appears to be a false positive.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS compliance on Shutterstock's own domain; the only claim originates from a third-party aggregator (Nudge Security), which is not vendor-domain proof.

certifications.name: FedRamp
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization. Shutterstock does not appear in the FedRAMP Marketplace (the public federal authorization registry); the third-party aggregator (Nudge Security) claim appears to be a false positive.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR Level 1 registration on Shutterstock's own domain; the only claim originates from a third-party aggregator (Nudge Security), which is not vendor-domain proof.

privacy.ai_training_note: Shutterstock explicitly does not train its own generative AI models on customer data. The platform distinguishes between contributor-licensed content (which users can opt out of for AI training; ~1% have opted out) and customer data. Amper Music is built on proprietary sample libraries and composition algorithms. The Shutterstock platform uses C2PA/IPTC industry standards to label AI-generated vs. human-created content.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly documented for Amper Music or Shutterstock. Specific customer-data residency regions are not stated on the vendor's own domain.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS (TLS) required for all API endpoints; base URL: https://api.shutterstock.com

security.name: API Authentication
security.value: OAuth 2.0 and API Key (Consumer Key/Secret) authentication; credentials should not be shared

security.name: Enterprise Security Features
security.value: SAML/SSO via Okta, Google, Microsoft integrations; security partners include Palo Alto Networks and OneTrust

security.name: AI Content Provenance
security.value: C2PA/IPTC standards used to label AI-generated vs. human-created content to safeguard against deepfakes and disinformation

products.name: Amper Music Web Platform
products.data_scope: User-created music compositions, prompt inputs, account metadata; does NOT include customer data in AI training
products.notes: Browser-based AI music composition tool. Users input mood, genre, tempo, instrumentation; AI generates royalty-free original music. Integrated into Shutterstock ecosystem.

products.name: Amper Music Mobile App
products.data_scope: Same as web platform; iOS and Android apps available. Published on Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
products.notes: Mobile version by Aliaksandr Tsvirko (per some sources as continuation of original Amper); enables offline composition.

products.name: Amper Music API
products.data_scope: API credentials, request logs, generated music metadata. No training on user-submitted compositions.
products.notes: Powers 10,000+ integrations. OAuth 2.0 / API Key auth. Subscription tiers: Free, Pro ($14.99/month), Enterprise (API + custom support).

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (limited free tier) + subscription tiers (Pro: $14.99/month) + Enterprise API licensing
compare.data_residency: Not publicly documented on the vendor domain.

flags: Every certification claim originates solely from a third-party aggregator, not from Shutterstock's own domain. Shutterstock's trust and security pages are not publicly accessible, so no certification can be verified on the vendor's own domain.
FedRAMP was claimed by a third-party aggregator, but Shutterstock does not appear in the FedRAMP Marketplace, the public federal authorization registry. The claim appears to be a false positive.

HIPAA was claimed by a third-party aggregator, but Shutterstock is a media licensing platform, not a healthcare covered entity or business associate. This claim appears to be a false positive; no BAA support is documented.
Shutterstock does not maintain a publicly accessible trust center or security page. Certifications cannot be independently verified without requesting attestations directly from the vendor.
Specific data storage regions for Amper Music customer data are not publicly documented. EU GDPR users should request a Data Processing Agreement with explicit residency terms.

The original standalone Amper Music platform is no longer offered as an independent service; capabilities were integrated into the Shutterstock ecosystem after the November 2020 acquisition. Any 'Amper Music' mobile app by a third-party developer is unrelated to Shutterstock and should not be attributed to this vendor.
